entities.name: Guaram I of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Guaram I was a Georgian prince, who attained to the hereditary rulership of Iberia and the East Roman (Byzantine) title of curopalates from 588 to c. 590. He is commonly identified with the Gurgenes of the Byzantine chronicler Theophanes.
